basic_profile.bio: Hi there! I'm a 28-year-old aspiring vanlifer based in Sydney, Australia. I've always loved the idea of living on the road, inspired by countless YouTube channels and Instagram accounts. While I work as a freelance graphic designer, I spend a lot of my spare time planning my van adventures. I'm in a committed relationship with my partner, who occasionally joins me on my trips. I'm a night owl and usually online late at night, exploring new ideas for van modifications or catching up on the latest Liverpool FC games. I dislike crowded spaces and prefer the peaceful solitude of nature.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a basic understanding of van conversions mostly gained through online resources like YouTube tutorials and Reddit threads. I have no formal training in mechanics or electrics but have taught myself enough to feel confident in making minor modifications to my van.
